causal_graphs.context: S. coelicolor M145 and scr2-deletion derivatives, Scr1 overexpression, liquid YES plus xylose, eight days.

evidence.explanation: Figure 3A-B compares deletion strains and expression constructs, with empty-vector controls and three independent experiments; supports the scoped phenotype dependency.
evidence.snippet: these two genes must act in conjunction

evidence.explanation: Identity/domain mapping only; the causal evidence comes from the primary experiment, not this automated annotation.

edges.mechanism: Loss of scr2 prevents induction by Scr1 alone; joint expression restores it. This is a conditional requirement, not sufficiency of Scr2.
edges.subject: scr2-present

causal_graphs.family_mapping: UniProt Q9KZY4 sequence version 1 is 63 residues; its Pfam PF04149 annotation spans residues 10-62. The experiment perturbs the whole gene.
causal_graphs.limitations: No direct Scr1-Scr2 binding or catalytic mechanism established here; no family-wide transfer. Other media, times and paralogs require separate graphs.

nodes.label: Scr2 present in a Scr1-overexpression background

causal_graphs.scope: Scr2 (SCO4442; UniProtKB:Q9KZY4), not all DUF397 proteins or an isolated domain.
causal_graphs.title: Scr2-dependent actinorhodin induction

causal_graphs.context: Solid R2YE, day 7; wild-type M145 comparator.

evidence.explanation: Results and Figure 5E image; Figure 6C includes joint complementation and empty-vector controls. The Figure 5 caption mislabels panels.
Identity and current domain coordinates only, not causal evidence.

edges.mechanism: Double deletion reduces the phenotype; joint complementation supports locus-level causality.
edges.subject: pair-deletion

causal_graphs.family_mapping: SCO7616 is UniProtKB:Q9F3E1, sequence version 1, 89 residues; current Pfam PF04149 feature spans 27-73. The study's Table 2 instead reports 27-63.
causal_graphs.limitations: Qualitative pigmentation phenotype; neither individual-gene contributions nor biochemical mechanism resolved. NMMP has the opposite direction.
causal_graphs.scope: Joint-gene perturbation in S. coelicolor M145, not isolated SCO7616 activity.
causal_graphs.title: SCO7615/SCO7616 deletion on R2YE

causal_graphs.context: Solid NMMP, day 7; wild-type M145 comparator.

evidence.explanation: Results and Figure 5E image, NMMP column, day 7.
Identity and current domain coordinates only, not causal evidence.

edges.mechanism: Double deletion increases the phenotype in this medium.
edges.subject: pair-deletion

causal_graphs.family_mapping: SCO7616 is UniProtKB:Q9F3E1, sequence version 1, 89 residues; current Pfam PF04149 feature spans 27-73. The study's Table 2 instead reports 27-63.
causal_graphs.limitations: Qualitative pigmentation phenotype; no NMMP rescue demonstrated here. R2YE rescue cannot establish medium-independent direction or a domain-specific mechanism.
